title: High-Dimensional Nonparametric Change-Point Detection via Low-Rank Degree-Three Density Projection
abstract: arXiv:2608.15466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Distributional changes can be invisible to means and covariances yet appear in skewness, asymmetric interactions, or other third-order structure. We develop a nonparametric change-point method that retains every degree-at-most-three coefficient of a density while avoiding direct density estimation. For observations in $[-1,1]^d$, we construct a symmetric order-three Legendre feature tensor $H_3(X)\in\Sym^3(\R^{d+1})$ such that $A(f)=\E_fH_3(X)$ is an exact isometric encoding of the degree-three density projection: $\|A(f)-A(g)\|_{\F}=\|P_3(f-g)\|_{L^2}$. Instead, fixed tensor contractions are degree-three polynomial chaoses with $\psi_{2/3}$ tails. The two terms have the characteristic order-three tensor scaling and match the powers in sharp concentration results for simple random tensors. For a coordinate-orthogonal specialization, the bound improves to $\sqrt{\log d}$ and enables a prefix-sum implementation in hundreds of dimensions. W

translated_title: 基于低秩三次密度投影的高维非参数变点检测
translated_abstract: 分布变化可能对均值和协方差不可见，却体现在偏度、非对称交互或其他三阶结构中。我们开发了一种非参数变点方法，保留密度的所有至多三次系数，同时避免直接密度估计。对于定义在$[-1,1]^d$中的观测值，我们构建了一个对称三阶勒让德特征张量$H_3(X)\in\Sym^3(\R^{d+1})$，使得$A(f)=\E_fH_3(X)$是三次密度投影的精确等距编码：$\|A(f)-A(g)\|_{\F}=\|P_3(f-g)\|_{L^2}$。相反，固定张量收缩是三次多项式混沌，具有$\psi_{2/3}$尾部。这两项具有特征性的三阶张量缩放，并与简单随机张量的尖锐集中结果中的幂次匹配。对于坐标正交特化，界限改进至$\sqrt{\log d}$，并支持在数百维中进行前缀和实现。
tldr: 本文提出一种无需密度估计的高维非参数变点检测方法，通过三阶勒让德张量精确编码密度投影，实现对偏度等三阶结构变化的有效检测，并在坐标正交情况下实现数百维的高效计算。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a high-dimensional nonparametric change-point detection method that avoids density estimation by using a third-order Legendre tensor to exactly encode density projections, enabling detection of skewness-related changes, with efficient prefix-sum implementation in hundreds of dimensions under coordinate-orthogonal specialization.
